phase_rs._comment: The pin itself is engine/phase.lock.json (image digest, server version, build, protocol). Update with `npm run deps -- update phase`.

17lands._comment: One snapshot per set. Raw files are not in git (data/17lands/). Codes: deps/set-codes.json. Refresh: `npm run deps -- update 17lands`.

unmapped.SPM: Arena released Marvel's Spider-Man as Through the Omenpaths (17Lands code OM1) with different card names, and 17Lands has only PickTwoDraft data for it. Ratings can't be matched to the phase-rs card names, so SPM has no human stats.

set_context._comment: MTG Deck Tools set contexts (knowledge level `primer`), exported from Magic-Deck-Builder src/setContexts. The Director prefers the published copy at the URL below and logs its sha256 per event. Refresh: `npm run deps -- update set-context`.

registry._comment: Owned by the model registry (registry/, packages/registry). Its version is a content hash computed by registryVersion().

scryfall._comment: Not pinned: the report site loads card images from Scryfall at view time. Card text and booster data come from phase-rs (built from MTGJSON/Scryfall upstream), pinned above.
